reading: The sketch lays out a festival landing page: a top nav, a giant two-line extruded "LOUD FEST" headline, a spinning jagged date badge reading "JUN 12", a checkerboard floor band, and two cards on that floor (a tilted "3 DAYS · 40 ACTS" tag and a "Weekend pass" card with a ticket button), all fully specified by the typed notes.
